evidence_location: paper Black Sea trend comparison; official product description, DOI, documentation, licence and access sections
finding: CR000280 is the CMEMS Black Sea Mean Sea Level time series and trend from Observations Reprocessing product, DOI 10.48670/moi-00215, explicitly used by Atlas paper 153 as a trend comparison. Existing PRL000032 is verified. Direct DOI redirect semantics were not independently observed; official product identity is verified and no data file was downloaded or parsed.
